cards.answer: Volibear is a fighter and tank who runs at enemies to stun them, then threatens repeat W casts for extra damage and healing. He deals physical and magic damage, with AD and AP scaling.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance during his approach, disengage while marked by W, and avoid relying on a turret during his ultimate.

cards.answer: Attacks and ability hits build stacks that grant attack speed. At full stacks, his attacks deal bonus magic damage that chains to nearby enemies.
cards.counterplay: Avoid prolonged trades and keep away from nearby targets he is attacking.

cards.answer: Q grants movement speed, increased while facing a nearby visible enemy champion, and empowers his next attack to pounce, deal bonus physical damage, and stun. Enemy immobilization or polymorph during Q ends the effect and resets its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Create distance during his approach; after interrupting Q, stay alert for another approach.

citations.quote: gaining bonus movement speed for 4 seconds, doubled while facing a nearby visible enemy champion.

During this time, Volibear's next basic attack has a modified windup time and is empowered to have an uncancellable windup, gain 25 bonus range, and pounce on the target, dealing bonus physical damage and stunning them for 1 second.

facts.claim: Q grants movement speed, increased while facing a nearby visible enemy champion, and empowers his next attack to pounce, deal bonus physical damage, and stun.

citations.quote: If Volibear becomes immobilized or polymorphed by an enemy during Thundering Smash, the effect ends prematurely and the cooldown is reset.

facts.claim: Enemy immobilization or polymorph during Q ends the effect and resets its cooldown.

cards.priority_reason: His primary approach and stun; the reset changes how opponents should respond to interruptions.

cards.answer: W deals physical damage, applies on-hit effects, and marks its target Wounded. Casting W on a Wounded target deals increased damage and heals Volibear based on his missing health.
cards.counterplay: Disengage while Wounded to reduce his opportunities to bite and heal.

citations.quote: Volibear slashes the target enemy with his claws to deal physical damage, apply on-hit effects, trigger on-attack effects, and mark the target Wounded for 8 seconds.

facts.claim: W deals physical damage, applies on-hit effects, and marks its target Wounded.

citations.quote: Wounded Bonus: Frenzied Maul deals increased damage and heals Volibear based on his missing health.

facts.claim: Casting W on a Wounded target deals increased damage and heals Volibear based on his missing health.

cards.priority_reason: Repeat casts create his central sustained fighting and healing threat.

cards.answer: E strikes a location after a delay, dealing magic damage based partly on enemies' maximum health and slowing them. Volibear gains a shield if he is inside the strike.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the strike area and avoid trading into his shield.

dealing magic damage to enemies hit based on their maximum health and slowing them for a short time.

facts.claim: E strikes a location after a delay, dealing magic damage based partly on enemies' maximum health and slowing them.

citations.quote: If Volibear is within the strike, he gains a shield

facts.claim: Volibear gains a shield if he is inside the strike.

cards.priority_reason: Combines delayed area damage and a slow with defensive shielding.

cards.answer: R grants bonus health and attack range as Volibear leaps to a location. His landing slows nearby enemies and deals physical damage in the center; nearby enemy turrets are damaged and temporarily unable to attack.
cards.counterplay: Move away from his landing area and retreat from dives instead of relying on turret protection.
